Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows elevated NT-proBNP, suggestive of possible heart failure or cardiac strain. There is mild normocytic anemia (low RBC, hemoglobin), increased red cell distribution width, and high LDL cholesterol, indicating cardiovascular risk. Slightly high chloride and low CO₂ may suggest mild metabolic acidosis. Iron is mildly elevated but ferritin is normal. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended, especially regarding cardiac status and anemia evaluation.
Provider Organization: Krankenhaus der Barmherzigen Schwestern Ried
